**[P1] Defer draining until the outermost hook releases `_lock`**

A content/result callback can re-enter `on_invocation_end` while an outer `_emit` still owns this `RLock`. This call then blocks in `drain()` with that outer lock acquisition still held. If the export worker invokes an exporter or record finalizer that re-enters any hook, it blocks on `_lock`, so the worker cannot publish completion and the invocation deadlocks. Defer the drain until the outermost hook frame unwinds, or build records outside the lock and revalidate before scheduling; add a test combining a reentrant end callback with exporter-side re-entry.
